policy.banner: SHADOW BOQ - NOT APPROVED FOR TENDER / CONTRACT - PRESENTATION VIEW OVER EVIDENCE - NO PRODUCTION MIGRATION
never: a sum or subtotal computed in the workbook
a quantity not copied from a report row
a summary and a breakdown presented as additive

sheets.00_READ_ME: banner, how to read, status legend, no formulas / prices
sheets.01_BOQ_SUMMARY: the TOTAL line of every item (one line per item)
sheets.02_ROOM_BREAKDOWN: room lines of the same items, each marked 'BREAKDOWN OF <item> (not additive)'
sheets.03_TRACEABILITY: one line per report row with every trace field
sheets.04_BLOCKERS_NOTES: one line per blocker of every item
sheets.05_RUN_INFO: run id, source revision, policies, report digest

why_not_the_suggested_trade_sheets: trade sheets (floors / wall finishes / waterproofing) would repeat the summary quantities in a second place and invite adding them; there is no OPENINGS BOQ item (reveals are inside the finish rows)
